records.title: A 51.6μJ/Token Subspace-Rotation-Based Dual-Quantized Large-language-Model Accelerator with Fused Scale-Activation INT Datapath and Rearranged Bit-Slice LUT Computation
records.reason: Primary IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/ISSCC49663.2026.11409212 was inaccessible. The abstract reports a dual-quantized LLM accelerator and energy/token metrics, but architecture, comparison baseline and limitations could not be checked.

records.title: The dilemma of coordinated communication in China’s e-cigarette governance: A computational discourse analysis of a social media controversy
records.reason: Primary DOI https://doi.org/10.18332/tid/215389 was inaccessible. The abstract concerns social-media discourse on e-cigarette governance, which appears outside scope, but the packet has an existing sparse-attention lineage link; the required primary-text check could not be completed.

records.title: A Mixture-of-Experts Model for Improved Generalization in Session-Aware Recommendation
records.reason: Primary MDPI DOI https://doi.org/10.3390/electronics15040825 was inaccessible. The abstract concerns session-aware recommendation MoE rather than LLM serving; linked MoE lineage requires primary review, but detailed method and limits could not be checked.

records.title: Beyond Student: An Asymmetric Network for Neural Network Inheritance
records.reason: InherNet uses asymmetric low-rank decomposition of a teacher network to build a smaller expressive student/inheriting model and evaluates accuracy/parameter trade-offs. The article does not establish LLM decode or serving benefits, leaving only an indirect compression connection.

records.title: Versor: A Geometric Sequence Architecture
records.reason: Versor replaces standard linear sequence operations with geometric-algebra transforms and reports large parameter-count reduction plus results on physical dynamics, reasoning, and WikiText-103. It is an architecture candidate with no serving latency/throughput evaluation and mixed non-language tasks; relevance to efficient LLM inference remains unresolved.
